summary: Frontend-only iteration_4 focused re-verification of the two regressions flagged in iteration_3 plus a light nav-regression pass. Both fixes verified end-to-end. (1) Portal sign-out from BOTH portals now correctly lands on Home ('/'), with protected-route redirect to /login still working after logout. (2) Consultation dialog now surfaces a visible success state ([data-testid='consultation-success'] with the heading 'Your note is on its way.') within 5s of submit. Full 12-route nav regression (6 therapist + 6 client) still passes with sole active nav and non-empty main content. No non-401 console errors observed. jsconfig.json remains deleted as requested. Refactor is complete.
critical_code_review_comments: PortalShell.doSignOut fix is minimal and correct — navigate('/', { replace: true }) is enqueued BEFORE await logout(), so the ProtectedRoute redirect race is now won by the /home push. Nice.

Consultation success block is now rendered inline in the same DialogContent (data-testid='consultation-success'), which is the correct pattern — no reliance on a toast that may or may not fire. Toast (sonner) still fires in parallel, which is also fine.

Follow-ups from iteration_3 still standing but non-blocking: two AuthContext modules (state/AuthContext.tsx + context/AuthContext.jsx shim) and two api modules (lib/api.js + lib/http.ts) — consolidate as feature migration proceeds. React Query provider mounted but feature pages still use useState+useEffect — dead-weight until migrated. ProtectedRoute uses sentinel `user === null | false` — consider a discriminated union to prevent future race conditions.
